text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Straight lines, whether written vertically 
or horizontally. There are no characters 
quite as honest and straightforward.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Especially today, since the 1 stands for 
"the fastest."
choice_data_list:
There's no doubt Light O was the fastest 
one today!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Today's fastest... did you notice? This 
'fastest' is merely the fastest for today, 
right here."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"The true peak of speed I'm aiming for is 
surely still far, far ahead."
choice_data_list:
If we keep going like this, we'll get 
there someday!

Never being satisfied and keeping on 
winning is the "shortest path"!

Never being satisfied and keeping on 
winning is the "shortest path"!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
In other words—if you want to be the 
absolute fastest, no looking aside. You 
can only reach it by keeping your eyes 
fixed forward.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Then there's no time like the present. I 
must fully commit to a lifestyle of 
looking only forward."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No good comes from dilly-dallying. Let us 
head straight home right now.
choice_data_list:
Then let's skip the cat café celebration 
for now.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
All I need to do is go straight to the cat 
café without any detours...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Keep taking first place. It is the 
simplest shortcut there is.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Above all, it suits me well. Taking the 
shortest route is my specialty, after all.
